item.title: DOJ says it's moving to end more than 50 decades-old school desegregation cases
item.description: The Justice Department said Thursday it was seeking to end more than 50 long-standing consent decrees dating back decades that sought to curb unlawful racial segregation that was prevalent during the Jim Crow era.

item.title: Would a diesel export ban work to lower prices?
item.description: Oil prices continue to rise as a result of the war with Iran. The average cost of regular gas is now $4.48, and diesel is $6.53, according to AAA. Yahoo Finance reporter Brooke DiPalma has more on whether a diesel export ban would be effective in curbing gas prices.

item.title: Netanyahu accuses U.N. delegates of "mind-blowing hypocrisy" for protesting his speech
item.description: At the U.N. General Assembly on Thursday, many of the gathered delegates staged a walkout as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu approached the podium. Aaron David Miller, senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, joins with analysis.

item.title: Hawaii under another hurricane watch as new storm closes in
item.description: Nolo could become a major hurricane by the weekend as it approaches Hawaii's Big Island, forecasters said.

item.title: U.S. government foots bill for pro-Trump, anti-communist ad amid lavish Xi welcome, halted press ban
item.description: A pro-Trump ad denouncing communism that was paid for by the U.S. government has hit the airwaves as the president hosts China's Xi Jinping, a communist, and as a judge blocks Mr. Trump's ban on three news outlets from the White House. CBS News' Weijia Jiang reports. Then, Steve Yates, former deputy national security adviser to Dick Cheney, joins with analysis.

item.title: Pentagon probing how shipment of F-35 fighter jet parts was diverted
item.description: The U.S. is trying to retrieve the parts, which were reported by Bloomberg News to be in China's possession.

item.title: Hurricane Polo is a powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico. See its path.
item.description: Hurricane Polo's intensity fluctuated between Category 4 and Category 5 — the strongest on the hurricane scale — off Mexico's southwestern coast. Here's the latest on its path.

item.title: New bill would lower Social Security retirement age for some workers
item.description: Workers in physically demanding jobs should be able to collect full Social Security retirement benefits at age 60, a Michigan lawmaker says.

item.title: Ezra Jin, Grace Jin Drexel speak out after his religious persecution in China
item.description: A Christian leader was released from a Chinese prison in July after President Trump pleaded his case with Chinese President Xi Jinping. The Chinese government arrested Ezra Jin in Beijing along with dozens of other religious leaders after church raids. Jin and his daughter, Grace Jin Drexel, join CBS News.

item.title: Trump administration urges Supreme Court to revive third-country deportation policy
item.description: The Trump administration urged the Supreme Court to revive its policy of deporting some migrants to places other than their country of birth.

item.title: Pittsburgh doctor attacked and killed while he slept, wife also stabbed
item.description: Dr. Idris Evans, a physician and medical director from UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, was killed in an overnight stabbing.

item.title: Man wounded during 2024 Trump rally shooting in Butler County dies
item.description: One of the men who was wounded in the 2024 attempted assassination of President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, has died.

item.title: Tropical Storm Nolo threatens Hawaii as nor'easter sets sights on East Coast
item.description: The U.S. is facing extreme weather across multiple regions, with Hawaii bracing for Tropical Storm Nolo and the East Coast preparing for a nor'easter. CBS News meteorologist Jessica Burch has the latest forecast.

item.title: Tillis says he wants to see Trump press China's Xi about helping Iran
item.description: GOP Sen. Thom Tillis of North Carolina told "CBS Evening News" anchor Tony Dokoupil that he would like to see President Trump press Chinese President Xi Jinping about supporting Iran through oil purchases and by providing the regime with satellite targeting data. "If we want to build a relationship, a productive relationship with XI Jinping and China, we also have to hold them accountable for things that are just simply unacceptable," Tillis said.

item.title: Sylvester Stallone jokes about one of his wildest jobs before fame
item.description: Sylvester Stallone said he took a series of odd jobs to make ends meet before the bruised but unbowed Rocky Balboa.

item.title: Officer thwarted Ontario synagogue shooting despite life-threatening injuries
item.description: Constable Jeff Smith was shot several times, suffering wounds to his head and torso, but continued fending off the attack until a second officer arrived.

item.title: Netanyahu says "shame on you" to Mamdani, claims "Jews no longer feel safe"
item.description: Netanyahu's address to the U.N. marks the first time he has visited New York since Mamdani became mayor.

item.title: California sheriff unlawfully seized ballots, state Supreme Court rules
item.description: The California Supreme Court ruled that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco violated that state's election law by ordering his deputies to seize more than 650,000 ballots.

item.title: Mortgage rates are back above 7%. How much higher could they climb?
item.description: Rates are "far more likely to go up than down by the end of the year," a senior economist at Realtor.com told CBS News.

item.title: Oil prices back up as U.S. and Iran trade threats to expand 7-month war
item.description: As Iran responds to Trump's threat of annihilation with its own warning of a possible "new front" in the war, global oil prices are rising again.

item.title: U.S. troops help Ecuador arrest dozens linked to ruthless cartel
item.description: The operation "was conducted jointly with U.S. troops and the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA)," Ecuador's interior minister said.

item.title: Netanyahu defends Israel in U.N. speech after several diplomats walk out
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended his country's military actions at the U.N. General Assembly on Thursday, with many diplomats walking out as he took the podium. CBS News' Olivia Gazis and Courtney Kealy join with analysis.

item.title: Israel's Netanyahu addresses U.N. as many leaders walk out
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu focused on Iran, and on defending Israel's actions in Gaza and the West Bank amid condemnation from fellow leaders at the U.N.

item.title: Was Hitler behind niece's death? Documents raise questions about alibi
item.description: Newly unearthed records have cast doubt on Adolf Hitler's whereabouts at the time of his niece's suspicious 1931 death, Der Spiegel reported.

item.title: Hiker falls over 800 feet to his death after another found dead on same mountain
item.description: A hiker fell between 800 and 1,000 feet to his death over the weekend, after going over the side of a switchback trail on Washington state's Sauk Mountain.

item.title: Taylor Swift to debut "Patient Zero" music video at VMAs. Watch a preview.
item.description: Taylor Swift announced her new single "Patient Zero" earlier this week, saying she has been "impatiently waiting" to announce that it will be out on Friday.

item.title: Disney is raising prices for Disney+ and Hulu. See the breakdown.
item.description: The price hikes for new subscribers are effective immediately. Existing subscribers' plans will go up next month.

item.title: Andreessen Horowitz launches AI school as college alternative
item.description: One of Silicon Valley's most prominent venture investors is gearing its new tech academy toward aspiring entrepreneurs focused on building AI.

item.title: Psychologist shares secret to overcoming challenges without losing your cool
item.description: Angela Duckworth, a psychologist and author, joins "CBS Mornings" to discuss her new book, "Situated: Find the People and Places That Bring Out Your Best." Duckworth reflects on her philosophy shift about the power of grit and shares ways that people can maximize their personal success.

item.title: 4 Army soldiers believed dead in helicopter crash in Washington state
item.description: The four service members were assigned to the 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment (Airborne), the Army said.
